summary: Flat kerb on a quiet residential street, homes roughly 10-13 m away.
reasons: Homes 10-13 m away on this side
Quiet street, a few cars parked

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings within 10 m of this section; houses 10-13 m along both ends and across the road. Tree belt screens the motorway to the west.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars and a boat parked along the kerb; room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street; motorway noise from the west, about 60 m away.
drivers.convention: Ordinary residential kerb with some parked cars; no camping convention.

flags: Steep elsewhere: up to 16% between 140 and 250 m
